resources.string: A little less scrolling. A little more watching.
TVmaze metadata and original network/platform. Not based on your watch history or a streaming-availability check for India. IMDb ratings are not connected.
Apple movie catalog for India. No audience ratings or Netflix/Prime/JioHotstar availability supplied.

One optional app; your actual launcher stays offline and unchanged. Watchroom is not a replacement Home app.

The default screen opens supported installed streaming apps, using their local logo resources. Their personalized recommendations and private watch histories stay inside those apps. Watchroom cannot import that history. Catalog exploration is separate and is not your Top picks.

TV shows: TVmaze metadata and thumbnails, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Explore catalog shows up to eight results for Dark, not personalized recommendations. Network/platform is the original outlet, NOT verified current availability in India. Provider scores are hidden. IMDb ratings are unavailable until a verified source is connected; TVmaze scores are not IMDb scores.

Movies: Apple Search API, India catalog. Only movie metadata and listing links are shown. Cross-provider availability is not supplied. Search is not a trending feed.

Weather: Open-Meteo, from city-level coordinates you enter. No GPS permission. Name and city label stay on this TV; coordinates necessarily reach Open-Meteo. Attribution: https://open-meteo.com/ (CC BY 4.0).

Only explicit catalog exploration downloads thumbnails: at most eight, bounded to 300 KB each and reused for the hero and cards. Likes save source links only on this TV; they do not import history or change recommendations. No trailers, ads, telemetry, background services, polling, boot receivers or account access. Leaving cancels in-flight work. Refresh occurs on return after 15 minutes or on request, not by a background timer. The visible clock updates once per minute. Subscription names/dates never go to providers. Catalog searches and your connection address reach the selected provider.

Subscriptions are user-entered dates, not an automatic billing feed. Monthly/yearly dates recur from the original date, clamping short months. No background reminders.

TVmaze: https://www.tvmaze.com/api
License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
